raw.description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

title: Licensed Customer Service Representative
description: Description Join Our Team as a Remote Experienced and Licensed Customer Service Representative! Within our Customer Response Center, the Remote Customer Service Representative provides timely, accurate and responsive information and service to policyholders and agents for a division of Personal Lines products, plans and programs. Independently solve problems relating to policies within scope and escalate others as appropriate. Identifies, analyzes, and owns customer policy needs to ensure high customer satisfaction, growth and retention of business. Training: Paid training is Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm EST (full time). Training is a critical component to your success, and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory for success in this role. Shift: After onboarding and training is complete, go-forward shifts will have a start time between Shift hours 8:30 am -10:30 am EST with a weekend rotation. One weekend day (Saturday or Sunday) will be required with an alternate day off mid-week when working the weekend. Work Location: All equipment is provided. However, to work from home you must have dependable, wired internet connectivity with an upload speed of at least 5Mbps and a download speed of at least 25Mbps along with a quiet, secure, distraction free place to work. License: Active P&C Producers insurance license REQUIRED. We are currently not hiring in NY, CA, AK, HI, NM or IL. Qualifications Associates degree or 1+ year Insurance experience preferred. 2 years'+ related Customer Service experience is required. Ability to review, record and organize written data from a variety of sources with no prescribed format is essential. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required. P&C Producers insurance license required. About Us Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role. At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. title: Service Locator
description: Building a sustainable tomorrow KierBAM are a Joint Venture (JV) partnership between Kier and BAM UK & Ireland - BAM UK & Ireland's infrastructure segment is currently delivering the redevelopment project at a Royal Navy site located in Plymouth and we are seeking an experienced Service Locator. The Service Locator will carry out the physical check and survey of all of the underground services within the area that is being investigated, the Service Locator will have the following responsibilities. You will use various geophysical techniques to locate the service, once they have been found, the services will be marked/spray painted onto the ground in the appropriate colour, defining the type and depth of the service. You will also maintain the contents of the permits on site, making sure the workforce remains compliant with conditions and processes outlined within the permits. Due to the site being a high-security military naval base, additional security checks will be required a BPSS level of security clearance is necessary. These checks can take up to 8 weeks to process. Only candidates holding EU, NATO, 5 Eyes, or MISWG member passports and who have been UK residents for the last 5 years can be considered for this role. Your team Location: Devonport Dockyard, Plymouth Contract: Permanent, 42.5 hours a week Making Possible In this role as Service Locator, you will be working in a live MOD facility. Your day-to-day tasks will include: Authorise Permit to Break Surface Ensure compliance with and enforcement of the project permit for the Break Ground procedure Review method statements tailored to specific tasks Mark all services within the work boundaries to protect colour standards Provide teams with an overview of the services within their designated work boundaries and discuss methods for working around those affected services. Implement an 8-point checklist during work gang briefings Enforce any designated exclusion zones surrounding affected services Obtain the required signatures for permit approval from the works team and the Project Engineer Notify the BOSC of any discrepancies in the records Investigate uncharted services as directed by the BOSC Inform the BOSC of any services that have been removed from the work area, ensuring the service drawings are updated accordingly Attach the most current SMD CAD drawing to the permit-to-dig Ensure that no work gang operates under an expired permit for breaking ground or in an area lacking a permit. Maintain service markings for the duration of the permit as well as incremental scans as excavations progress This profile is not exhaustive. From time to time, you may be required by the Company to perform other tasks, which are not included in the above description, but are within your capabilities and, where necessary, training, and full support will be given What do you bring to the role? Essential: We are seeking a candidate who can handle multiple tasks, show flexibility, and become a key contributor to our team A CSCS Card is required (this must be obtained before commencing work) Familiarity with Electromagnetic location and ground penetrating radar is essential A solid understanding of industry practices and standards related to utility detection, including PAS 128 and TSA, is important Candidates should have a proficient working knowledge of surveying equipment, such as GPR, CAT, and Genny utility detection tools The ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team and interact with clients on-site is required Knowledge of HSG-47 and GS-6 Desirable Experience in the Nuclear environment would be considered beneficial QCF Level 3 or Level 5 certification in utility mapping is preferred Applicants should possess a minimum of 2-3 years of utility surveying experience Whats in it for you? Competitive salary A wide range of family-friendly policies Company car/car allowance/travel allowance 8 % matched pension contributions Private healthcare Life assurance 26 days holiday 2 wellbeing days 1 volunteering day Personal and professional development About BAM Building a sustainable tomorrow. Thats our mission and our promise at BAM. Its how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe. Location: Remote - California (San Diego or Southern California Preferred)

About Pacific Health Group

At Pacific Health Group, we care deeply about the people and communities we serve. We meet individuals with kindness, respect, and understandingâlistening first, honoring each person's journey, and offering support without judgment.

Through compassionate, person-centered healthcare, behavioral health services, and social supports, we walk alongside people as they work toward healing, stability, and a healthier, more hopeful life.

Our Core Values

  • Speak with integrityâclear, respectful, and honest in every interaction

  • Build genuine connections with members, families, and teammates through empathy and cultural sensitivity
  • Lead with trust by being consistent, transparent, and following through
  • Celebrate wins together, recognizing individual and team achievements
  • Collaborate with purpose, partnering across departments and with community providers to solve problems
  • Ask for support and offer support, because thriving together is how we serve our members best

Role Overview & Impact

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Coordination

  • Support candidate communications using approved templates
  • Track candidate status and documentation in the applicant tracking system
  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)
  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

  • Submission of an internal application
  • Recruiter pre-screen
  • Skills assessment if applicable
  • Final interview with hiring leadership
  • Formal verbal offer from authorized hiring representatives

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

AI & Human Interaction in Recruitment

Pacific Health Group uses AI tools to assist with resume matching based on qualifications, skills, and location. All qualified applications are reviewed by our recruiting and HR team to ensure fair, equitable, and human-centered hiring decisions.

You will be required to work on a flexible schedule on weekdays, weekends and evenings according to range reservations/ schedules as presented by the Company Office.

You must be a self-starter, demonstrate a good work ethic and provide superior customer service. You will need to display good communication in the English Language as well as inter-personal and organizational skills. Within your duties you will be expected to interface with DND/Police/civilian range users as well as assigned subcontractors.

Key Responsibilities

Your duties include

Scheduling

  • Repair targets/backings 1080 fig. 11 targets/backings and 1080 targets/backings for fig 12 at Winona Range as well as replacement of 24 figure 11 target frames and 48 target frames for figure 12.
  • Repairs include removing and replacing the paper target figures.
  • Provide flexible hours to accommodate the march in/ march out process which includes occasional evening/weekend activity
  • Oversee in and out inspections.
  • Regularly inspect all range property and infrastructure reporting work order needs to the Company office as required and conducting dayâto-day operation and maintenance as required
  • With exercise directors (OIC Exercise) conduct in/out inspections ensuring the ranges and buildings are properly returned as found by the users and March in/out forms are signed by the Exercise representative
  • Reporting, recording all incidents, damages, causes and vandalism (including graffiti in the Butts)
  • Report malfunctioning installed equipment including kitchen and laundry equipment
  • Get Project Manager authority before calling in subcontractors;
  • Ensuring First Aid Fire Fighting equipment/supplies are maintained and replenished.

Maintain Ranges/infrastructure

  • Walk the perimeter fence lines ensuring the fences are kept in good repair and growth is cut back to an acceptable level
  • Complete all grass cutting and snow removal and ice control operations with equipment provided iaw the performance standards provided by the Regional Manager
  • Prune trees, shrubs and plants as required for neat appearance and maintenance.
  • Build/Repair target frames ensuring sufficient are on-hand at all times replacing

Facilitiesâ Housekeeping

  • Conduct janitorial services in all range buildings.
  • Conduct routine repairs paying particular attention to occupant safety, protection of occupants and property against further damage
  • Provide janitorial supplies as required to assist Range visitors;
  • Institute suitable waste disposal and materials recycling;
  • Take appropriate measures for the control of pests both indoors and outdoors;
  • Pick up litter and garbage as required.

GENERAL REQUIREMNTS

  • Must work flexible hours according to Range reservations;
  • Must be prepared to wear and respond to calls

title: Product Engineer
description: About SuperPlane SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it. The Role We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end. This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range. At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day. We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build. What We Are Looking For You are genuinely full-stack. About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.

Executive Operations & Project Manager

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Hours: Approximately 10 Hours per Week to Start

Compensation: $25â35/hour (Based on Experience)



About Viva Wellness Drip

Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

Position Overview

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:


Executive Operations

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
  • Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
  • Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
  • Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
  • Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule.


Business Operations

  • Organize company files, documents, and internal systems.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.


Preferred

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
  • Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.


You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.


Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.


Compensation & Growth

This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.


The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.


Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.


Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?

At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.


Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.

  • If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter, your work has a meaningful impact, and your career can grow alongside an innovative company, we'd love to hear from you.

description: POSITION OVERVIEW: Society 18 is seeking a highly organized, creative, and proactive Associate of Events, Social & Influencer Marketing to support the agency's creator partnerships, experiential marketing initiatives, social media presence, and day-to-day operations. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves bringing ideas to life, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and is passionate about influencer marketing, social media, events, and creator culture. The Associate will work cross-functionally across events, social media, talent, partnerships, and operations while helping execute high-impact campaigns and experiences for creators and brand partners. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Social Media Marketing & Content Creation Manage day-to-day content planning for Society 18's Instagram and LinkedIn channels. Develop monthly content calendars aligned with agency campaigns, partnerships, creator announcements, and events. Write engaging social media copy, captions, and assist with music selection for short-form content. Design graphics in Canva, including creator announcements, milestone graphics, birthday posts, event promotions, partnership assets, and press announcements. Film and edit Instagram Reels, creator spotlights, event recap videos, and partnership content using CapCut. Maintain Instagram feed planning and overall visual consistency. Schedule and publish content across social media platforms. Publish Instagram Stories daily. Engage with creators, brand partners, and community members through comments and direct messages. Maintain creator posting trackers to ensure balanced representation across agency channels. Develop quarterly newsletters and email marketing campaigns in Flodesk. Create LinkedIn content highlighting agency partnerships, company milestones, leadership updates, and industry news. Build and maintain creator pages on the Society 18 website. Update creator biographies, follower counts, categories, and roster information as needed. Event Production & Experiential Marketing Assist with planning and executing creator dinners, networking mixers, brand activations, gifting experiences, industry events, and experiential campaigns from concept through post-event reporting. Develop and maintain event production documents, including run-of-show schedules, timelines, itineraries, outreach trackers, and production checklists. Research, source, and coordinate event venues, restaurants, and vendor partners. Build and maintain agency venues and preferred vendor databases. Coordinate pricing, proposals, availability, contracts, and logistics with vendors. Support sponsorship outreach and assist in preparing partnership proposals and presentations. Manage creator invitations, RSVPs, guest lists, and attendee communications using CreatorIQ, Partiful, Airtable, and Google Sheets. Coordinate gifting logistics, product shipments, and vendor deliveries for events. Prepare Independent Contractor Agreements (ICAs), NDAs, vendor agreements, and supporting documentation. Organize event assets, contracts, invoices, presentations, production documents, and creative files in Dropbox. Provide on-site event support, including setup, vendor management, guest check-in, production coordination, and event breakdown. Capture behind-the-scenes photo and video content for real-time social media coverage. Create post-event recap presentations in Canva and track creator coverage using Archive. Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships Pitch creators for brand activations, networking events, creator trips, fashion weeks, festivals, and industry experiences, including ESSENCE Festival, New York Fashion Week, Coachella, and other cultural moments. Support creator onboarding by updating internal databases, website profiles, onboarding materials, and social media assets. Assist with proactive creator pitching for paid brand partnerships. Support talent scouting initiatives and maintain the agency's talent scouting database. Research new creators, emerging trends, and partnership opportunities. Executive & Administrative Operations Coordinate meetings, calendars, and scheduling with creators, brands, vendors, and internal team members. Prepare meeting agendas, capture notes, and distribute follow-up action items. Maintain internal databases, presentations, production trackers, reporting dashboards, and operational documents. Research and source brand contacts across beauty, fashion, travel, hospitality, wellness, food & beverage, and lifestyle industries using Apollo, Airtable, LinkedIn, and additional research tools. Support day-to-day agency operations and assist with special projects as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Event Management, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 1â3 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, events, talent management, PR, or a related field. Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Strong creative eye for branding, design, and social content. Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: The ideal candidate is creative, resourceful, highly organized, and excited to help build meaningful experiences for creators and brand partners. They enjoy bringing ideas to life, solving problems, collaborating across teams, and staying on top of emerging social and cultural trends. They are equally comfortable planning an event, editing a Reel, coordinating logistics, mentoring interns, or supporting creator partnershipsâalways with a positive attitude and strong attention to detail. title: A Book of Your Own
description: Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission. It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you. I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes. It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages. There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book. Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own? Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject? Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book. Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book. title: This IS Your Dream Job
description: Here are two questions to ask yourself: 1) when are you most content? (Not âhappyâ per se, since happy moments are fleeting. 2) Does contentment ever happen for you during the workday? The average American worker spends 2080 hours per year on paid work. Over 30 years, that adds up to 62,400 hours. Thatâs a LOT of time to spend doing something you donât like doing. Research also shows that people will change careers at least 7 times during their lifetime. However, career changes arenât always drastic â you can change the focus of your daily work activity without changing jobs. Sometimes incremental shiftsâsmall changes in what you do and how you do itâare the best and most satisfying way to land that dream job The key is to concentrate on ways to shift paid job duties into activities that give you that feeling of contentment. Grab a Sheet Of Paper And a Pencilâor Open Up Your Favorite Word Processor And Work Through The Following Steps To Come Up With Your Own Action Plan To Realize Your Dream Job STEP 1: Think about your current job â make a list of the tasks that comprise your job. Highlight the ones you most enjoy performing in your job. Note the ones you canât stand STEP 2: Make a list of activities youâve done in the past that you are most proud of, and that you got the most satisfaction from. These can come from previous jobs, volunteer activities, school work, or hobbies. If you loved laying out the college newspaper, but hated the organizational aspects such as chasing people down to get their content in on time, then that tells you something about the types of activities that work for you. STEP 3: Envision your ideal job â and list the tasks that it would encompass. What basic skills involved in your ideal job could start working on today? This could be something simple â if your ideal job is to be in charge of all written communication for your organization, an area you could start working on immediately is your writing skills. Even if your current writing skills are pretty good, there is always room to work towards a higher level of achievement. STEP 4: Now take the list of tasks and activities from steps 1 & 2 above, along with the list of skills from step 3, and group them into functions related to your job that you could concentrate on. (For example, if you are a financial analyst, but you find the grind of financial reports tedious, but you love creating charts and graphs and putting together presentations that visually demonstrate trends â your tasks and activities list could include âcreating graphs & chartsâ, and one skill that could be on your list is â Enhance MS Excel charting & graphing skillsâ . STEP 5: Conduct some research into the training available out there that would help you to enhance the skills you outlined in step 3. This could involve a number of options â anything from volunteering with an organization in a capacity where you could practice your skills, to taking webinars, intensive workshops, certificate programs, or working toward a degree. STEP 6: Using the information you gathered in step 5 above, get started with the training program(s) that will meet your individual needs. Remember that you can start small and fine-tune your training plan as you go along. You can also mix and match various training components â it doesnât have to be a straight path, as long as it gets you to where you want to go. Get involved with online forums and interest groups that will help you learn more about the latest techniques in your area of interest. As you spend more time learning and practicing, your skills will improve. Never underestimate the value of volunteering without asking for additional compensationâ¦your boss and superiors will be impressed that you are interested enough to take on a project without asking for something in return. Showcase your best efforts by volunteering to work on projects that will give you a chance to demonstrate your expertise. Land Mines to Avoid Being your own worst enemy â downplaying your talents wonât get you noticed or into consideration for that great new project. Toot your own horn and let others know that you are good at xyz (in the example above, creating charts and graphs). Just as important, offer to help others with that task â soon you will become the resident expert, the one that others turn to for help and advice on this topic Being finished with learning â remember learning doesnât stop because you have that framed diploma. Keep taking courses, attending seminars and staying in touch with others in your field so that you stay at the leading edge of knowledge and practice in your area of interest Getting stuck in a rut â Sometimes it seems easier to lay low and just plod along. But you canât stay still â keep looking for new opportunities to apply your talents and showcase them in new and interesting ways. Decide what you like (and what you donât), do your homework, work hard at new opportunities and advertise the resultsâbefore you know it, youâll be living your dream job.
